response.sql: WITH sentiment_trans_trader AS (SELECT sf.optvolrt, tr.transreg, t.tradekind FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg WHERE sf.optvolrt IS NOT NULL AND t.tradekind IS NOT NULL), pair_stats AS (SELECT transreg, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) as pair_avg_optvolrt FROM sentiment_trans_trader GROUP BY transreg, tradekind), overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) as overall_avg_optvolrt FROM sentiment_trans_trader), pair_with_deviation AS (SELECT ps.transreg, ps.tradekind, ps.pair_avg_optvolrt, os.overall_avg_optvolrt, ps.pair_avg_optvolrt - os.overall_avg_optvolrt as pair_deviation FROM pair_stats ps CROSS JOIN overall_stats os WHERE os.overall_avg_optvolrt IS NOT NULL), type_avg_dev AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_deviation) as type_avg_deviation FROM pair_with_deviation GROUP BY tradekind), filtered_pairs AS (SELECT pwd.transreg, pwd.tradekind, pwd.pair_avg_optvolrt, pwd.pair_deviation, tad.type_avg_deviation, pwd.pair_deviation - tad.type_avg_deviation as excess FROM pair_with_deviation pwd INNER JOIN type_avg_dev tad ON pwd.tradekind = tad.tradekind WHERE pwd.pair_deviation > tad.type_avg_deviation) SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_avg_optvolrt) as avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(pair_deviation) as avg_deviation, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM filtered_pairs GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind
